title: Package hydration Deck
summary: Package one or more Stacks into a runnable job boundary.
body:
## Goal
Package a workflow into a Deck that declares the job boundary and the Stacks available inside it.

## Hydrate
- Stack ids and summaries
- the job boundary
- the intended host or model context
- the expected Run outcome

## Do
1. Name the Deck by the job it performs, not by implementation details.
2. Include only Stacks that belong inside this job boundary.
3. Write the summary as the host-facing routing line.
4. Check that the Deck does not mix unrelated workflows.
5. Create the Deck with makeDeck() so id and seal are computed.

## Produce
A Deck record with title, summary, stacks[], and computed id/seal from makeDeck().

## Stop when
The Deck represents one runnable workflow boundary and every Stack belongs to that boundary.

## Carry
deck id, deck fingerprint, stack ids, job boundary

## Purge
unrelated stack candidates and host-specific scratch notes
